 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 OUT: PDF Download, Exam Time & Latest Updates
 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 is out. The board exams will begin on February 16 and continue until April 9, 2027. Check the subject-wise examination dates, paper timings and download the official CBSE timetable PDF.

 What Should Students Do After the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 Release? 
 The CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 has been released by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on November 6, 2026. Students appearing for the Class 12 Board Examinations 2027 can now check the subject-wise examination schedule, paper timings and important instructions in the official timetable.
 As per the released schedule, the CBSE Board Exams 2027 Class 12 will begin on February 16, 2027, with the Physics examination. The examinations will continue until April 9, 2027. Students from Science, Commerce, Humanities and other streams can check their respective subject dates in the official date sheet PDF.
 All examinations will commence at 10:30 AM (IST). The duration of each paper will depend on the subject. CBSE has released the Class 10 date sheet along with the Class 12 CBSE Date Sheet 2027 . Students can download the official schedule from the CBSE website and plan their preparation accordingly.
 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 Out: Latest Updates
 CBSE has issued the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 Board Examinations 2027 through an official notice dated November 6, 2026.
 The timetable includes the examination dates and subject codes for students appearing in the Senior School Certificate Examination 2027. The Board has considered subject combinations, examination centre arrangements and other scheduling requirements while preparing the timetable.
 Here are the key highlights:
 The CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027 will begin on February 16, 2027.
 The last examination is scheduled for April 9, 2027.
 Students will appear in 121 subjects.
 More than 19.8 lakh students have registered for the Class 12 examination.
 All examinations will begin at 10:30 AM (IST).
 The duration of the examination will vary according to the subject.
 The Class 10 and Class 12 date sheets have been released together.

 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 PDF Download
 Students can download the CBSE Class 12 Board Exam Date Sheet 2027 PDF from the official CBSE website. The PDF contains the complete subject-wise timetable, examination dates and other important instructions.
 Follow these steps to download the date sheet:
 Visit the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in .
 Open the latest examination-related notifications.
 Find the notice titled Date Sheet for Class X and Class XII Board Examinations, 2027.
 Click the official date sheet PDF link.
 Open the timetable and locate the Class 12 examination schedule.
 Check your subject codes, examination dates and paper timings.
 Download and save the PDF for future reference.
 Official date sheet: Visit the CBSE website .
 Students should use the official CBSE PDF to verify their examination schedule. The same notice contains the Class 10 and Class 12 date sheets.

 CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027: Important Instructions
 Students should read the examination instructions mentioned in the official date sheet and admit card carefully.
 Check the examination date and subject code before every paper.
 All examinations will begin at 10:30 AM (IST).
 The examination duration will vary according to the subject.
 Carry the CBSE admit card and other permitted documents to the examination centre.
 Follow the reporting time and instructions mentioned on the admit card.
 Do not carry mobile phones or other prohibited electronic devices into the examination hall.
 Read the question paper instructions carefully before starting the examination.
 Follow all instructions issued by CBSE and the examination centre.
 After checking the CBSE Class 12 exam schedule, students can practise with CBSE Sample Papers 2026-27 
 How Did CBSE Prepare the Class 12 Date Sheet 2027?
 CBSE considered several factors while preparing the Class 12 examination timetable. According to the official notice dated November 6, 2026, the Board considered more than 40,000 subject combinations while preparing the date sheets.
 The major factors include:
 1. Subject combinations: CBSE considered the subjects selected by students to avoid clashes between examinations of commonly selected subject combinations.
 2. Adequate gaps between papers: The timetable provides gaps between examinations of subjects commonly offered together, allowing students time for preparation.
 3. Entrance examination schedules: The tentative schedules of major entrance examinations for Class 12 students were considered while preparing the timetable.
 4. Examination centre arrangements: The number of candidates appearing on a particular day at each examination centre was considered to support smooth examination arrangements.
 5. Evaluation process: The Board also considered the evaluation schedule to reduce prolonged teacher absence from schools.
 Practice with CBSE Class 12 Previous Year Question Papers (PYQs) to understand the board exam pattern, review questions from past exams, and improve your preparation with regular practice.
 What Should Students Do After the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 Release?
 With the examination timetable available, students should prepare a subject-wise study and revision plan. A clear schedule can help students complete their syllabus and revise important topics before the examinations.
 Prepare a subject-wise revision plan: Allocate time according to the dates of your upcoming papers.
 Complete the syllabus: Identify pending chapters and complete them before starting full-length revision.
 Practise sample papers: Solve CBSE sample papers to understand the question pattern and marking scheme.
 Revise important concepts: Focus on formulas, definitions, diagrams, numerical problems and key topics.
 Practise previous-year questions: Use previous-year papers to improve answer-writing speed and time management.
 Check practical and internal assessment updates: Follow your school's instructions regarding practical examinations, projects and internal assessments.
 Verify subject codes: Match the subject codes in the date sheet with the subjects selected in your school records.
 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 FAQs
 Is the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 released?
 Yes. CBSE released the Class 12 Board Examination 2027 date sheet on November 6, 2026. Students can download the official timetable from cbse.gov.in. Where can students access the Class 12 routine?
 Students can access the official notification directly on the board website at cbse.gov.in. What details are mentioned in the date sheet PDF?
 The document lists subject names, official subject codes, examination dates, reporting hours, shift duration, and candidate instructions. Are practical exams conducted alongside theory papers?
 No, CBSE conducts practical assessments, internal evaluations, and project vivas separately before theory examinations commence. Have questions about your prep?
